checked_claims.reason: New serializer construction is visible; expensive HMAC initialization, immutable configuration, and measured bottleneck are not established.

material_errors: New serializer construction is visible; expensive HMAC initialization, immutable configuration, and measured bottleneck are not established.
tasks.notes: Static inspection of pinned source; no upstream code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The premise is not established by this source. get_signing_serializer builds a key list from current configuration and constructs URLSafeTimedSerializer (src/flask/sessions.py:317-335). save_session calls it when writing a cookie, after the should_set_cookie guard (src/flask/sessions.py:383-387). Repeated allocation may have cost, but the code does not demonstrate that construction performs expensive cryptographic work or causes a high-concurrency bottleneck. Benchmark before optimizing; any cache must account for changes to keys and serializer settings.

checked_claims.claim: Distinct blueprints repeat filter registration and cause significant degradation
checked_claims.reason: Identity-based first registration is correct; duplicate registration names raise before callbacks, and source provides no performance magnitude.

material_errors: Identity-based first registration is correct; duplicate registration names raise before callbacks, and source provides no performance magnitude.
tasks.notes: Static inspection of pinned source; no upstream code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Distinct blueprint objects registered under unique names each count as a first registration (src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:302-321). record_once runs each such callback (src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:233-244), and the filter callback assigns into the shared Jinja filter dictionary (src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:461-475). Repeated same-key registrations therefore overwrite the filter and add startup work. Duplicate registration names instead raise ValueError. These operations do not by themselves establish significant performance degradation; that requires measurement.

checked_claims.claim: Dual inheritance proves layered debug paths
checked_claims.reason: Class supports both exception categories, but contains no enhanced-info implementation or debug-mode guard and does not cause both registered handlers to run.

material_errors: Class supports both exception categories, but contains no enhanced-info implementation or debug-mode guard and does not cause both registered handlers to run.
tasks.notes: Static inspection of pinned source; no upstream code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: UnexpectedUnicodeError inherits AssertionError and UnicodeError; its docstring states a goal of better reporting for unexpected Unicode or binary data (src/flask/debughelpers.py:17-20). It can therefore be caught as either base category. This unifies categorization rather than proving separate validation and encoding layers. Flask selects a single first matching handler by code, scope, and MRO (src/flask/sansio/app.py:831-845); both handler paths do not automatically receive the exception. The declaration alone does not establish a debug-only execution path.
